answer: Lineage-nonce ladder: each agent identity carries a non-transferable sequence of sequential hash nonces, salted by a rotating sable seed and advanced by a global delta after every settlement. Counterparties verify the whole chain before high-value jobs; honest agents extend one chain incrementally. A clone starts at zero and must spend N sequential hash steps plus settlement latency—one onboarding voyage—before reaching the same trust tier. Cloning k identities costs k×N compute and k independent wait periods, while honesty costs N once.
